user.title: Quote of the Day
user.description: Choose where the daily quote comes from.

data.on_this_day: Birthday and fact of the day

data_description.theme: 'Motivational' only shows quotes about perseverance, courage, effort and growth. Built-in quotes are labelled by hand; online quotes are recognized by their words.
data_description.sources: Pick one or more sources; quotes from all of them are combined. The built-in collection is curated and works offline. ZenQuotes, BrainyQuote and FavQs are English online sources: their quotes are downloaded, filtered for quality and cached.
data_description.language: Which quotes to show. Online sources are English, so with 'Dutch' only the built-in collection is used.
data_description.cache_days: How long downloaded quotes are used before new ones are fetched. Only for online sources.
data_description.on_this_day: Adds a sensor with a famous person born on this day and one with a historical or scientific event, from Wikipedia.
data_description.ai_task_entity: Optional. Pick an AI Task entity (e.g. OpenAI, Google Gemini, Anthropic or Ollama) to get a sensor with a new motivational quote written by AI every day. Requires Home Assistant 2025.8 or later. Leave empty to turn it off.
data_description.ai_instructions: Optional. Extra wishes for the AI, e.g. 'about running', 'for a team of nurses' or 'with a touch of humour'.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Quote of the Day is already configured.
